title: RNAseq: mRNA to Illumina library
protocol: Assess mRNA using Agilent RNA 6000 Nano kit.
Run each mRNA sample in duplicate.
Ensure each sample contains between 10-400ng of mRNA.
Proceed with Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Preparation Guide, Low Sample Protocol.
Add mix to the desired amount of mRNA starting at page 20 step #12.
Concentrate mRNA into 5 µL or less for optimal results; up to 42 µL can be used.
Skip page 22 step #2 if starting with mRNA without beads.
Transfer 17 µL of mRNA/mix at step #3 and continue the protocol as specified.
Assess quantity of dsDNA library using Quant-iT™ PicoGreen® dsDNA Assay Kit.
Ensure the final product has a size of approximately 260bp when assessed with Agilent High Sensitivity DNA Kit.
